descriptionChirho: The proper name Yepheth (יֶפֶת), the eldest (or youngest, debated) son of Noah, ancestor of the Indo-European and northern peoples in the Table of Nations (Gen 5:32, 6:10, 7:13, 9:18, 23, 27, 10:1, 2, 21; 1 Chr 1:4, 5). All three clusters are the same personal name in different syntactic frames: bare or with lamed (S103077, 5x), with waw-copulative (S103078, 4x), and another waw-copulative or bare variant (S103079, 2x). Multilingual evidence is uniform: Spanish Yafet/Yefet, Arabic يَافِثَ (Yāfith), Hindi याफेत (Yāphet), Korean 야벳/야벟 (Yabet), Swahili Yafethi. No semantic distinction exists between clusters.
